THE HARAS01 —

Horses first.
Always.

Great horsemanship starts with the individual. At Prépinson, we give every horse the time, attention and space to become the best version of itself.

A private haras in the Belgian Ardennes, dedicated to breeding, young horse development and exceptional daily care.
